provenance.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: Dino Atlas gallery color-pattern diversity candidate, anatomy-review only
Input images: Image 1 is an identity and body-proportion reference only, not an edit target. Create a new scene and new pose while preserving its slender Herrerasaurus identity.
Primary request: One Herrerasaurus ischigualastensis walking alertly through broken shade beside a shallow Late Triassic floodplain channel. Keep a charcoal and restrained russet mottled palette, but do not copy Image 1's left-facing lateral pose, horizon, or framing.
Scene/backdrop: Ischigualasto Formation in Argentina, red silt channel edge, sparse low shrubs and a few open-canopy plants casting long broken shadows, early morning light.
Subject: preserve Image 1's narrow closed toothed skull, long neck, slender horizontal torso, relatively long compact forelimbs, two strong hind legs, and one long balancing tail; do not enlarge the head or thicken the body.
Style/medium: highly detailed natural-history museum paleoart, realistic living animal, original project-owned visual, no named-artist or franchise style.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, low front-right three-quarter camera. The animal moves from the background-right toward the foreground-left with its head turned across the frame. Its body forms a diagonal in depth, not a flat side profile. The one tail recedes in an arc toward the upper-right. Both arms are held close to the chest and separated by open negative space; one hind foot is planted and the other is mid-step. Keep the full tail tip and every foot in frame.
Critical anatomy lock: exactly two forelimbs, exactly two hind legs, exactly one tail. Each compact hand has three main clawed functional fingers and only tiny clawless reduced outer digits; no long dangling hooks. Hind feet have three main forward weight-bearing toes and a small rear hallux. Every limb must connect cleanly to its own shoulder or hip; no extra arm, third leg, duplicate foot, fused limb, or floating hand.
Constraints: calm walking only; no other animal; no attack; no blood; no text; no watermark; no logo; no feathers, horns, crest, oversized tyrannosaur head, giant hands, or cropped extremity.
